review.independence: Two separate blinded Codex agent reviews, source references sealed before outputs; not human validated. Secondary covers preselected balanced subset and all material disputes; prose language cannot be fully hidden.

content_convention: Conservative reviewed subset combination: good requires both, bad/claims uses either/max; per-reviewer preserved. A false finding faithfully rendered is still factually false. Disputed no joint credit. Main reference inventory from sealed primary source; secondary source conflicts remain disputes.
claim_count_convention: Combined attribution counts are per-ID per-category maxima across reviewers: conservative upper envelopes, not deduplicated assertion totals. A disputed inherited/new attribution can appear in both combined categories; use reviewer_separate_totals for each independent assertion count.
